about.title: Ibyerekeye New Textile Social Company Limited
about.hero_subtitle: Ahantu heza ho gushakira imyenda myiza, amarido, imyenda, n'imyambaro gakondo i Rwanda.
about.story_p1: New Textile Social Company Limited, izwi nka DENISE, yashinzwe n'intego yo kuzanira amazu y'u Rwanda n'ubucuruzi imyenda y'ibyiciro byose.
about.story_p2: Dutekereza ku mvumo, inkingi n'ibikoresho by'amarido, imyambaro gakondo y'u Rwanda, imyenda yo kwambara, no gutura mu nzu.
about.story_p3: Uburyo bwacu budasanzwe butuma abakiriya bareba ibicuruzwa byacu kuri interineti, befunge ibyabo, no kuza mu iduka ryacu i Kigali kugira ngo barebe, bemeze no gusoza kugura.
about.mission_desc: Kuzanira buri rugo n'ubucuruzi y'u Rwanda imyenda myiza, ku giciro cyiza, hamwe n'inama nyazo na serivisi wagarukaho.
about.vision_desc: Kuba iryambere Abanyarwanda batekereza iyo bashaka amarido, imyenda n'imyambaro gakondo, mu ntara zose z'igihugu.
about.value1_desc: Dushaka gusa imyenda myiza cyane ku bakiriya bacu
about.value2_desc: Gushyigikira abanyabukorikori bo mu Rwanda n'ubukorikori bwaho
about.value3_desc: Tufite ishema ry'uba i Kigali, tukorera u Rwanda rwose
about.value4_desc: Serivisi yihariye ya hejuru ya buri mukiriya
